entities.name: Abu Sufyan ibn Harb
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sakhr ibn Harb ibn Umayya, commonly known by his kunya Abu Sufyan, was a prominent opponent-turned companion and father-in-law of the Islamic prophet Muhammad. He was the father of the first Umayyad caliph Mu'awiya I and namesake of the Sufyanid line of Umayyad caliphs which ruled from 661 to 684.
